descriptions.text: Toraline Root Vegetable. Alchemy Material. This rare tuber only grows in dirt that has been covered by lava. They are very rare. Nobody ever goes digging them up, either. You know why? Because they taste like dogshit, that's why. They're pretty much useless. In fact, fuck you for wasting my time with this.

recap.text: Carl tosses the yam from the anti-crawl group's silver box into his inventory. Mordecai, with Samantha's help, works out that it grows in lava and yields potions at an eighth of the vegetable apiece. Carl drinks Mordecai's phase potion as Chris erupts from the sand, then reaches into Chris's head for the worm in his brain. A woman tells Dr. Hu that half the yam was wasted on saving that other crawler.

A benefactor box brings a Pawna's Cries potion and a note: Save the toraline. More than half of it is already gone, into the potion that let Carl pull Maggie out of Chris's brain. Carl asks save it for what, and why the sender won't say; Mordecai answers that notes are paid by the character, and the rules force the sender to be cryptic. Then Carl's Escape Plan skill buzzes, and more words appear on the page.

Carl watches a photo on Shadow Boxer's roundabout show him chopping potatoes beside a jug marked Milk, though no one let him near that kitchen except to clean it. Shi Maria, in Carl's body, burns through the floor with Self-Immolation, then jabs the tattoo kit's stick into Li Jun's eye. She dips it in the beaker holding a sliver of toraline, now black ink, and pokes it rapidly into Carl's chest.

Rosetta lays an icy hand on Carl's Bedlam Bride tattoo and asks how much toraline and spider ink he has left. Over chat she warns him to say nothing aloud. He hands over a finger-sized slice and a few thimblefuls of the still-hot ink Shi Maria brewed. Mordecai has more toraline, he says, but not much. Rosetta asks for access to his saferoom so they can get to work.

beats.headline: Thanks for the yam
beats.text: Carl hands Mordecai a batch of Mairmei Mushroom from a desk in the basement. Then the boxes. After the Valtay pill comes the silver box from the anti-crawl group, a spiral galaxy symbol on it, and inside is what looks like a sweet potato. Mordecai has never seen one. He has seen potions that need something similar, mostly salves for scaled creatures, or it might be a traditional marriage proposal. Carl tosses it into his inventory. Thanks for the yam, mystery aliens.
beats.gist: Carl hands Mordecai mushrooms, then opens a silver box holding a sweet potato-like yam that Mordecai cannot identify.

beats.headline: An eighth a potion
beats.text: Thanks to Samantha's help, Mordecai has figured out the yam thing, and he wants Carl back at the saferoom: he has a potion for him. While the rest of the plan waits, Mordecai is in the crafting room working on the second potion made from it. Each one takes only about an eighth of the vegetable, and Carl tells him they had better have at least three, one each for him, Katia and Donut.
beats.gist: Mordecai brews yam potions, an eighth of the yam each, and Carl wants three.

beats.headline: Grown in lava
beats.text: Carl tells the hidden Chris, and Maggie inside him, what the yam is. It grows in lava or magma, and it makes either a special ink for scrolls or a few lava-themed potions: a healing scroll for lava rock monsters like Chris, or a phase potion to pass through lava rock. Mordecai made the phase potion. When Chris erupts from the sand beside the winding box, Carl drinks it, and as Chris hurls the box away, Carl reaches into his head for the worm lodged in his brain.
beats.gist: Carl tells Chris the yam grows in lava, then drinks Mordecai's phase potion and reaches into Chris's head.

beats.headline: Wasted half of it
beats.text: A woman asks Dr. Hu how much they have spent, and he says it is best she does not know. She lists the dangers: Carl is unstable, he could die at any moment, and he is not nearly as clever as Hu thinks. You should have included instructions with the yam, she says. They wasted half of it on saving that other crawler. He knows what it's really for, says Dr. Hu. Does he? She is not so sure.
beats.gist: A woman tells Dr. Hu the yam's cost, Carl's instability, and the half they wasted saving another crawler.

beats.headline: Save the toraline
beats.text: A benefactor box brings a Pawna's Cries potion and, unusually, a note. It says simply: Save the toraline. More than half of it is already gone, into the potion that let Carl pull Maggie out of Chris's brain. Save it for what, Carl asks, and why won't they just spit it out? Notes are expensive, says Mordecai: they are paid by the character, and the rules force the sender to be cryptic. Then Carl's Escape Plan skill buzzes, and more words appear on the page.
beats.gist: A benefactor's note says to save the toraline, but over half is already gone.

beats.headline: Potatoes and milk
beats.text: On Shadow Boxer, a photo on the roundabout shows Carl chopping potatoes beside a jug marked Milk, a photo that cannot exist: they never let him near that kitchen except to clean it, the jug is shaped like a two-litre soda bottle, and the camera would be standing in a wall. His stew was milk and potatoes, he says. Potatoes are very versatile. Very, Rosetta agrees, and vanishes mid-sentence: Harbinger has stopped the interview. Carl remembers a rant of Milk's in the cookbook, and a reply he is fairly sure was Rosetta's. Just like all root vegetables. The toraline.
beats.gist: Carl finds an impossible photo of himself chopping potatoes, and Rosetta vanishes when Harbinger stops the interview.

beats.headline: Ink in a beaker
beats.text: Shi Maria has Carl's body. Going through his inventory she finds a potion and wants to know what he made it with, and then an empty beaker he looted on the first floor is in his hands, a small sliver of the toraline inside it. Mordecai still has the biggest piece. She casts Self-Immolation, which burns through the floor beneath him, and once he has dropped into the apartment below, the hot beaker holds a little bubbling black ink. She unequips his shirt and takes out the stick-and-poke tattoo kit, jabs its stick into Li Jun's eye when he comes close, then dips it in the beaker and pokes the ink rapidly into Carl's chest.
beats.gist: Shi Maria, in Carl's body, burns through the floor and turns toraline into ink for a chest tattoo.

beats.headline: A finger-sized slice
beats.text: Rosetta, in person, puts an icy hand on the Bedlam Bride tattoo and asks how much Carl has left. Of what? The toraline, she says, and the ink the spider used to make that tattoo. Over chat she warns him to say nothing out loud. He hands over all he has, a finger-sized slice, and the still-hot glass of the ink Shi Maria brewed, a few thimblefuls left. Mordecai has more of the toraline, he says, but not much. Give me access to your saferoom, she says, and we will get to work.
beats.gist: Rosetta takes Carl's last toraline and the ink left from Shi Maria's brew.
